direction: About 9 seconds. Wide still with a slow pull-back. The drover drives the cattle out through the far gate as the rain thickens. The surveyor, alone in the yard, shelters his board under his coat-tail. Ambience: rain, hooves fading.

still.prompt: Photoreal 16:9 wide still, Welsh farmyard, c. 1790, in light rain. A drover in a long wool coat drives black cattle out through a far wooden gate. In the foreground a surveyor in a dark frock coat and round hat shields a plane table with the skirt of his coat. A whitewashed stone farmhouse and outbuildings stand around him, with wet mud, grey light and inland hills. Period-accurate. Invented faces, no text, no heraldry.
